title: Prefilled Forms META Overlay
description: Overlay schema for records that produce filled copies of published PDF forms. The record names the forms it issues and where they land; the bindings themselves live in form packs, because a published form's field names belong to that form rather than to any one record.

packs.description: Form packs this record adds to the ones the repository already configures, resolved the way other pack paths are. A record needs these only for a form the repository does not configure for everything.

outputs.description: The filled forms this record issues. Ordered, because a record that issues several is read in the order it lists them.

form.description: Form id declared by one of the resolved form packs.

path.description: Where the filled form is written, relative to the record directory.

label.description: Human label for the issued form, for listings and packet entries.

flatten.description: Paint the values into the page and remove the form, so the result can be bound into another document without leaving widgets behind that belong to no form. A flattened copy can no longer be edited or read back as field data. Defaults to false.
